releases.notes:
## 1.56.0

Everything since 1.52.0.

**New**
- **Safe mode follows the server.** *Auto* (default) switches itself on at FunTime, ReallyWorld and HolyWorld (recognised by domain, subdomains too), switches off what each project's rules do not allow and keeps it off, then puts it back when you leave; in single player and on other servers it does nothing. *Always* blocks every risky module everywhere. The lists come from the projects' published rules and can go out of date; they are not an approval of the mod by any server.
- **HolyWorld In-Game API (Feature Control).** On HolyWorld the mod sends its list of features and the server answers with the ones it blocks; those modules are switched off and hidden from the menu, search and the AI's list. Only the list is sent, no account, nick or settings.
- **NameTags** puts the Neuro Canvas logo in front of the nick of other mod users in the player list (Tab); the plate above the head is now an option, off by default.
- **NeuroAura is now NeuroConfig** (the AI chat); your old settings carry over.
- **WorldLyrics:** words appear one by one in the air in front of you (*Words in view*), the text reads correctly from every side, lyrics are searched more carefully (your own `.lrc` files first, looser retries, NetEase as a last resort, credit lines removed), music icon in the player card.

**Fixes**
- WorldLyrics text no longer mirrored; the glow no longer pops out at the end of a word.

Client-only Fabric 1.20.1 mod, needs Fabric API. Licence: GPLv3.

releases.notes:
## 1.52.0

Everything since 1.40.0.

**New**
- **Ambience:** a shader sky with ten looks (Space, Black hole, Aurora, Synthwave, Dusk, Meteor shower, Milky Way, Eclipse, Planet, Nebula); stars turn with the time of day, shooting stars, fog that follows the sky. **NorthernLights** is now painted on the sky itself.
- **WorldLyrics:** the words of the song that plays, in the 3D world, word by word. Reads the music of the browser (userscript), the system player (Windows, macOS, Linux) or `.txt`/`.lrc` files; lyrics from LRCLIB; player card with the cover.
- **WorldBridge:** play your single-player world with friends through an address like `xxxx.neuro-connect.x-vare.com` (up to 20 players, 5 hours; guest rules, optional Mojang check). Needs the project server to have it enabled.
- **KillEffects:** 17 more styles, and effects that change the dead body itself (Ice freezes and shatters it, Cubes, Hologram, Implode); *Deaths* setting; kills detected from the server's death signal.
- **TargetESP:** Neon Ring, Phantom (hologram model), Orbiting Crystals, Lightning ring; soft glow without smoothstep; rounded line ends and corners.
- **EnchantGlint**, **NoLimited**, **HUD size** (global and per module), ViewModel editing in the chat, swing easing with Slap and Spear, Configs in the Market, tick-box lists for Share/Unshare.
- **Minecraft GUI:** themed title screen, hotbar, tab list, scoreboard, subtitles, loading screens, 11 animated background styles; the menu opens from any screen.
- Modules moved to better categories (Visuals, Misc); HandTrails removed.

**Security**
- Key and token files are created owner-only; the AI key is never sent over plain http outside your network; the now-playing port ignores web pages (**copy the browser script again**, it is version 1.1 now).

Client-only Fabric 1.20.1 mod, needs Fabric API. Licence: GPLv3.

## 1.40.0

- **HUD panels:** the player list (Tab), the scoreboard, the name of the held item and the subtitles sit on themed panels with the opacity the game uses (*GUI hotbar and HUD*).
- **Loading screens:** connecting, terrain download, world loading, progress and saving screens get a themed background and three pulsing dots at the bottom (*GUI loading screen*).
- **Kill effects:** kills are now detected from the server's death signal and from the moment an entity leaves the world, so players that a server removes at once are counted too; hitting someone else afterwards no longer loses the kill; killing the same player again right away plays the effect again. New *Deaths* setting: your kills, players, or everyone in range.
- Includes 1.39.1 (17 new kill effects, share/unshare pickers, configs in the Market).

## 1.39.1

Everything since 1.31.0:

- **Minecraft GUI, phase 2:** the hotbar (sliding selected cell, off-hand slot), experience bar, boss bars and chat take the theme (*GUI hotbar and HUD*).
- **Title screen:** themed background and buttons, our logo instead of the Mojang one, themed language and accessibility buttons, no splash text (*GUI title screen*).
- **11 animated menu backgrounds** (*GUI background style*): Aurora, Gradient, Mesh, Curtains, Smoke, Stars, Synthwave, Bokeh, Metaballs, Cells, Dots, Stripes, Waves.
- **The Neuro Canvas menu opens from any screen** with its key (Right Shift by default), including the title menu; closing returns to that screen.
- **Share / Unshare** in the cosmetics now open a list with tick boxes: pick which items to upload or take down.
- **Configs in the Market:** a new *Configs* tab; publish a preset (or your current settings) from the Configs page with *Publish to Market*, apply someone else's with *Get* (your old settings are saved as a preset first).
- **KillEffects:** 17 new styles (Ash, Embers, Shatter, Ice, Confetti, Black hole, Fireworks, Tornado, Steam, Petals, Rain, Shockwave, Beam, Voxels, Melt, Bubbles, Random), *Natural colours*, and a *Deaths* setting: your own kills, players, or everyone in range.
- HandTrails was removed.

Client-only Fabric 1.20.1 mod, needs Fabric API. Licence: GPLv3.

## 1.31.0

Part 4 of the Minecraft GUI redesign: **the loading screen**.

- The screen shown while the game starts and while resources reload (a resource pack change, F3+T) keeps the game's own timing, fading and error handling, but the red is replaced by the theme's dark colour, the Mojang logo by the Neuro Canvas logo with a soft glow, and the white bar by a thin accent progress bar. No text is drawn on it (the fonts may not be loaded yet).
- Interface: *GUI loading screen* turns it off. The first frames of the start can still be vanilla, because the screen can appear before the mod has read its settings.
- Includes 1.30.0 (scrollbars, checkboxes, tabs, toasts).
